lede: The biggest thing to watch this week is Mountain Village Town Council on Thursday, where an ordinance on first reading would move Housing Authority fees out of municipal code and into an annually updated fee schedule — a structural shift in how affordable housing costs get set that deserves public attention. Meanwhile, San Miguel County's Housing Code SSR working group meets Tuesday to keep chipping away at Land Use Code barriers to workforce housing, and HARC takes up a potential demolition and new construction application for Rebekah Hall — the town-owned building where HARC itself meets — on Wednesday.
